image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a handmade baby bib lying flat on a white textured surface (likely a blanket). The bib features a white central panel with vertical pleats or stitching, bordered by pink fabric with large white and green polka dots. The entire edge is trimmed with light blue ruffled lace. A yellow ribbon or tie is visible at the top neck area.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bib and not misidentified as a general cloth or napkin due to the complex patterns.
To verify the structural integrity of the complex ruffled lace trim and ensure it connects logically to the main body without AI-induced melting or fusion artifacts.
To check for subtle texture inconsistencies in the polka dot pattern and the pleated white fabric, ensuring they follow natural physical folds.

focus_areas: Integrity of the blue ruffled lace trim
Consistency of the polka dot pattern across folds
Connection point of the yellow neck tie
Physical plausibility of the fabric draping
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the blue lace trim; AI often struggles with repetitive, fine-detail structures like lace, causing them to melt into the background or the main fabric. Verify if the polka dots distort naturally with the fabric curves or if they 'swim' unnaturally. Check if the yellow tie at the top has a clear origin point or if it emerges ambiguously from the fabric.
